context_for_next_testing_agent: Finance PDF Report feature fully functional. 4 PDF endpoints: /api/finance/reports/pdf/overview, /api/finance/reports/pdf/income-expense (with period param), /api/finance/reports/pdf/department, /api/finance/reports/pdf/outstanding.
